description: This Kotlin source file defines a DemoNotificationsEngine class used for generating and managing demo notifications within an Android shopping app. It simulates order status updates and cart reminders, handling scheduling, persistence, and notification generation without backend support.

classes.name: DemoNotificationsEngine
classes.description: Class responsible for generating and scheduling local demo notifications for order statuses and cart reminders in the app. It manages persistence, scheduling, and cancellation of notifications, and simulates a notification backend for demo purposes.

methods.name: isDemoEnabled
methods.description: Checks if demo notifications are enabled via shared preferences.

methods.name: setDemoEnabled
methods.description: Enables or disables demo notifications; cancels or restores scheduled notifications accordingly.

methods.name: clearAllNotifications
methods.description: Clears all notifications via the repository and cancels scheduled tasks.

methods.name: markAllRead
methods.description: Marks all notifications as read using the repository.

methods.name: generateOrderNotification
methods.description: Creates and adds a local notification for a given order status.

methods.name: onOrderPlacedHook
methods.description: Called after an order is placed, schedules follow-up notifications with delays.

methods.name: onCartActivityHook
methods.description: Schedules a cart reminder based on cart activity.

methods.name: scheduleOnce
methods.description: Schedules a one-time action with a delay, avoiding duplicates.

methods.name: cancelScheduled
methods.description: Cancels a scheduled notification task by key.

methods.name: clearPendingSchedule
methods.description: Clears currently pending scheduled notifications from preferences.

methods.name: restorePendingScheduleIfAny
methods.description: Restores scheduled notifications after app restart based on saved schedule info.

methods.name: buildNotification
methods.description: Constructs a NotificationItem instance with provided details.
